note: Independent audit of RFC 4271 Section 9.1.2.2: "If an implementation chooses to remove MULTI_EXIT_DISC, then the optional comparison on MULTI_EXIT_DISC, if performed, MUST be performed only among EBGP-learned routes." Ze compares MED across eBGP and iBGP candidates sharing a neighbor AS (bestpath.go::comparePair), confines configured del { med; } to import before Phases 1 and 2 (filter_modify.go::medRemoveFor, external_attributes.go::removeMED), and guards internal readvertisement against raw post-selection MED omission in forward_med.go::applyFactsMED. TestRFC4271OrdinarySelectedMEDSurvivesRawEgressRemoval proves mixed iBGP/eBGP same-neighbor-AS (65010) MED comparison and ordinary bgp-rib selected-route iBGP readvertisement restore selected MED alongside the raw filter's community marker while sparing a no-MED control, explicit egress MED Set 7, and iBGP split horizon. test/plugin/med-ibgp-ordinary-post-selection-removal.ci and checkMEDIBGPOrdinaryPostSelectionRemovalGoBGP prove the same ordinary bgp-rib preservation and no-MED control end-to-end over TCP and against FRR/GoBGP.
